decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory tightly complementary to the firm’s core footwear business, the comfort insole remains a cheap option to keep open while demand and differentiation versus other insoles continue to become clearer.

The firefighter and rescue boots line is a higher-commitment niche product, but it fits the firm’s protective-footwear capabilities and specialist reputation well enough that management would keep the option open for another year rather than exit prematurely.
